overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Vorarlberg 5 Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna offers a luxurious retreat right in your backyard, designed to enhance relaxation and wellness. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood with a clear stain, this sauna combines traditional aesthetics with modern technology, featuring an 8.0 kW stove and an interior chromotherapy lighting system with red light therapy for muscle relaxation and stress relief. Enjoy the convenience of an LED control panel with Bluetooth connectivity and built-in speakers, creating a personalized spa experience. Ideal for outdoor settings, this sauna is perfect for those seeking a serene escape to improve circulation and overall well-being.

Golden Designs traditional saunas provide a healthier way to live. Enjoy the wealth of health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life!
